summary: Investigation phase using grep to survey git, unity, svelte, and activity references across the agent-server and app lib, followed by git status/log inspection across the gizmo and gizmo-registry repos. The agent then summarized that the registry now owns all extensions (Activity, Ask User, Git, Skill Authoring, Svelte, Unity) with Gizmo's built-in web extensions removed, an NCP issue resolved by splitting Pi extension dirs from web bundles, and full check/build passing in both repos.
decisions: All extensions (Activity, Ask User, Git, Skill Authoring, Svelte, Unity) live in gizmo-registry as Pi extensions with optional paired Gizmo web integration, rather than in the Gizmo repo

Gizmo's gizmo.extensions.json is empty; the app starts with no built-in web extensions and discovers Pi extension factories, gizmoExtension host capabilities, and gizmoWebExtension browser bundles from linked registry directories

Browser bundles are placed in ~/.pi/agent/extension-web/ rather than ~/.pi/agent/extensions/, keeping Pi backend directories separate so relative imports and registry dependencies resolve correctly via directory links
errors: NCP issue where browser bundles were placed inside Pi's extension directory; resolved by relocating web bundles to ~/.pi/agent/extension-web/
